about: Golden queries for retrieval quality. Windows are wide on purpose. When a ranking bug is found, add a test with a `regression` note (see scripts/golden.py).

tests.query: oblivion
tests.why: An agent asking about Oblivion must meet the graph card, the OpenOblivion notes and the Bethesda skill first.

tests.query: MSVC RTTI vtable
tests.why: RTTI/vtable work belongs to re-binary-recon, its technique note and the RTTI reference.

tests.query: oblivion
tests.regression: 2026-10-06: after findings and experiments were indexed, 12 findings filled the top 12 for 'oblivion' (each repeated the game name in the triple-weighted field and the records are short) and the Bethesda skill dropped to rank 20. Fixed by moving linked-node names out of the weighted field and capping results per kind when several kinds are searched.
tests.why: A one-word game query must still lead to the game's skill and notes.

tests.query: android arm64 GLES emulator
tests.why: The emulator field note and the failed experiment answer this exactly.

tests.query: N64 static recompilation
tests.regression: 2026-10-06 baseline: the project group led with Halo 3 Delta, Crackdown 2 and Strider 2 (non-N64) because 'N64' never matched 'Nintendo 64' and nothing connected the query to N64Recomp. Fixed by graph aliases (query expansion) and graph_boost of projects the graph links to the named approach/platform.
tests.why: N64 static recompilation should surface N64Recomp-based projects and the method, not other consoles.

tests.query: player stairs collision
tests.regression: 2026-10-06 baseline: the top hits were a WoW 'pulled through the floor' note and unrelated mashup/engine sections; the compendium had no physics knowledge. Fixed by the Havok/physics references, experiments and findings.
tests.why: Movement/physics knowledge, not asset tools or unrelated games.
